title: Library Import only works after second folder added
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

Brand new user.  I went to Library Import, added folder and nothing happens.  I'm only presented with a "Choose Another Folder" button.  Only after adding a second folder does the import start working, and only on the second folder.

### Expected Behavior

I expect that, after adding the first folder, that it should scan those folders and allow importing.

### Steps To Reproduce

_No response_

### Environment

```markdown
- OS: Windows 64
- Sonarr: Version 4.0.19.2979
```

### What branch are you running?

Main

### Trace Logs

Debug log only starts after new series starts importing, therefore no debug log.

### Anything else

_No response_
